summary: 分词作定语、状语、表语和宾补。核心区别：现在分词（doing）表主动/进行，过去分词（done）表被动/完成。

rules.title: 作定语：单个分词前置，短语后置
rules.detail: a sleeping baby（睡着的宝宝，主动） vs a fallen leaf（落叶，已完成）；a broken window（被打碎的窗，被动）。

examples.zh: 熟睡的宝宝看起来很可爱。

examples.en: The window broken by the boys needs repairing.
examples.zh: 被男孩们打碎的窗户需要修理。

rules.title: 作状语：逻辑主语 = 主句主语
rules.detail: 分词短语作状语表示时间、原因、伴随等。主语主动发作用 doing，被动承受用 done。

examples.en: Hearing the news, she jumped with joy.
examples.zh: 听到消息，她高兴得跳了起来。

examples.en: Seen from the hill, the town looks beautiful.
He sat there, reading a novel.
examples.zh: 他坐在那里，读着一本小说。

rules.title: 作宾补：see / hear / find / keep / have + 宾语 + 分词
rules.detail: 现在分词表主动进行（I saw him crossing the street. 他正在过马路）；过去分词表被动完成（I had my hair cut. 我剪了头发）。

examples.en: We heard her singing in the next room.
examples.zh: 我们听到她在隔壁唱歌。

examples.en: He spoke loudly to make himself heard.
examples.zh: 他大声说话好让别人听见。

pitfalls: 主动被动用反：❌ the story interesting by him → 他讲的故事用 told by him；被讲的故事不说 interesting by
悬垂分词：分词的逻辑主语必须 = 主句主语。❌ Walking in the street, a car hit him. → ✓ While he was walking..., a car hit him.
have sb do / have sb doing / have sth done 混淆

questions.stem: The ___ girl sat in the corner, saying nothing.
questions.explain: 女孩「感到害怕」用过去分词 frightened（人作主语表感受）。

questions.stem: ___ from space, the earth looks like a blue ball.
questions.explain: 地球是「被看」，逻辑主语 the earth 与 see 是被动关系，用过去分词 Seen。

questions.stem: The teacher came in, ___ by a group of students.
questions.explain: 老师是「被跟着」，用过去分词 followed。

questions.stem: My car broke down, so I had it ___ at once.
questions.explain: have sth done = 让某物被（别人）做：车被修。

questions.stem: ___ (work) hard, you will make great progress. （用所给词的适当形式）
questions.explain: you 与 work 是主动关系，分词作条件状语：Working hard。

questions.stem: The film ___ (show) last week was a great success.
questions.explain: 电影「被放映」，用过去分词 shown 作后置定语。

questions.stem: Walking along the lake, the flowers looked very beautiful.
questions.answer: Walking along the lake, we found the flowers very beautiful.（或：Walking along the lake 逻辑主语与主句不一致，需改写）
questions.explain: 主句主语是 flowers，但 flowers 不会「走在湖边」，分词逻辑主语与主句主语不一致（悬垂分词）。

questions.stem: 这是一部由真实故事改编的电影。（翻译整句，base）
answer: this is a film based on a true story.
this is a movie based on a true story.
questions.explain: 电影「被基于」，用过去分词 based on 作后置定语。

questions.stem: 听到这个好消息，我们都欢呼起来。（翻译整句）
answer: hearing the good news, we all cheered.
when we heard the good news, we all cheered.
questions.explain: we 与 hear 是主动关系，用现在分词短语作时间状语。
